name: Carol Blood
desc: politician from the U.S. state of Nebraska
summary: Carol Blood (née Vacek; born March 5, 1961) is an American politician from the U.S. state of Nebraska. In 2016, she was elected to represent District 3 in Sarpy County in the Nebraska Legislature with 51.56% of the vote. In 2020 she was re-elected with 50.4% of the vote.
